topic: Admission Leads Page - Filters and Global Search
summary: Explains how filters on the Admission Leads page control lead visibility, focusing on default settings for 'not engaged' and 'engaged with pending follow-up' leads, and how negative tags hide leads by default. It also details the use of 'Global Search' to find any lead regardless of applied filters.
steps: By default, the system only ticks 'Not engaged' and 'Engaged with pending follow-up' statuses.
By default, only positive tags are selected in the filter, hiding leads with negative tags.
To view leads with negative tags:
Select the specific negative tag (e.g., 'Not Interested') from the filter.
Select 'Engaged with pending' and 'Completed follow-up' statuses.
Reload the page to reset default filters.
Enter the application number; the lead will be visible regardless of other filters.
business_rules: Negative tags hide leads from the default view to prevent counselors from seeing irrelevant data.
Global Search bypasses all active filters to locate any lead by application number.
important_notes: Counselors typically only see positive leads by default to focus on actionable leads.
Global Search is a powerful tool for finding leads that might be hidden by filters.
